attributes.powers: For your combat check against a monster, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 3d6+3. If it is a non-villain monster that has an adventure deck number of 4 or lower, it is defeated.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 12 or Divine 14 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
